stories.title: Bucs, Mayfield reach 3-year, $165M extension, sources say
stories.summary: The Buccaneers and quarterback Baker Mayfield have agreed to a three-year, $165 million extension, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: MAC reverses course, wants WMU recognized as winner in Michigan game
stories.summary: The MAC has appealed the outcome of the game between Western Michigan and Michigan, asking the NCAA and CFP to recognize the Broncos as the winner.

stories.title: Tiafoe makes semis with stunning US Open comeback last done by Federer
stories.summary: Frances Tiafoe kept coming back until he had reached his third US Open semifinal, beating fellow American Alex Michelsen 5-7, 3-6, 7-5, 6-3, 7-6 (10-6) on Tuesday.

stories.title: LIV Golf officially files for bankruptcy protection; Rahm, Bryson owed millions
stories.summary: LIV Golf and its related entities voluntarily filed for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court of New Jersey on Tuesday, with court records listing Jon Rahm ($7.5 million) and Bryson DeChambeau ($5.7 million) as the league's top creditors.

stories.title: Judge returns for Yankees, goes 0-3 in opener vs. Rockies
stories.summary: New York outfielder Aaron Judge, out since May 31, made his long-awaited return from a fractured rib on Tuesday against the Colorado Rockies, going 0-for-3 with two strikeouts and a flyout before being removed in the sixth inning with the Yankees up 2-1.
